svg.title: BuildBuddy validation data flow
svg.desc: An immutable source revision enters a credential-free Bazel validation job. Bazel runs eligible actions locally, queries a trust-scoped remote cache, and emits minimized build events to a separately controlled Build Event Service. Cache hits and local action results feed tests, whose result remains bound to the source SHA. Remote execution is a separate optional path requiring explicit authorization and configuration, not an implication of cache or event ingestion.
